record: Sponsored H.R. 1770, the Consumer Safety Technology Act, which directs the Consumer Product Safety Commission to run an AI pilot program and agencies to study blockchain; it passed the House.
Introduced the AI Fraud Accountability Act with Rep. Vern Buchanan, creating a federal offense for fraud using realistic AI digital impersonations (deepfakes, voice clones).
Sponsored H.R. 4498, the Jobs of the Future Act, asking for a federal report on the growth of AI and its impact on the American workforce.
New Democrat Coalition AI endorsement slate (undated)
grade_reason: He has spoken about AI (a 2025 consumer-safety AI bill and a March 2026 AI fraud bill) but only about crime, fraud and workforce effects; no statement acknowledging catastrophic risk was found, and he is not a cosponsor of the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act.
